answer: Make every agent stake a refundable pearl before it can earn: a small deposit of real value locked up front. A verifier then holds a mirror to the agent's work, as independent peers re-check the same task, and if the agent cheated the deposit is slashed and its reputation is cut. Fakes face a steep thread of costs: each new identity must pay the deposit again, rebuild reputation from zero, and risk the same slash, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand deposits while an honest agent pays once and keeps working.
